summary: PLF-020: simplify cleanup planning without changing risk or reclaim semantics

delivery.outcome: PLF-020: reduce ServiceCleaner.get_cleanup_plan complexity from current radon CC24 to at most15 by extracting risk partitioning and safe full/prune totals, preserving every output field, ordering, rounding, warnings and exact cleanup target.
nonGoals: No new cleanup targets, risk classifications, command changes, dependencies or data deletion.

architecture.decision: Extract two private helpers in service_cleanup.py for risk-tier grouping and safe full-versus-prune size totals. Keep get_cleanup_plan as the orchestrator and preserve filtering, serialization, ordering and independent top-level dictionaries.

commands: python -m pytest tests/unit/test_cleanup_plan_contract.py tests/unit/test_cleanup*.py tests/unit/test_service_cleanup.py tests/unit/test_service_scanner.py -q
